title: Building the main menu and save system for my UE5 historical survival horror (Solo Dev). What do you think of the vibe?
author: OddLibrarian4204

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
the devil going across the screen ruins the vibe; it's so janky it looks comical, but even if it didn't, it's too on the nose for effective horror 

horror wants to be as minimalist as possible. fear lives in the unseen

replies.author: OddLibrarian4204
replies.body:
Thanks a lot for the honest feedback!

You're spot on about the animation-the leg run cycle is just a basic placeholder right now, and completely reworking and polishing it is high on my to-do list.

Regarding the concept: the goal with the little devil wasn't to deliver a cheap jump scare, but rather to pay homage to medieval manuscript illustrations (marginalia) from the 1348 Black Plague era. That said, I totally get your point about minimalism and how true horror lives in what remains unseen. I'l definitely take this feedback to test more subtle approaches and see what captures the atmosphere best.

Thanks for stopping by and sharing your thoughts.
